business_problem: The Commonwealth wanted to improve the speed, clarity, accessibility, and accuracy of public services while reducing manual effort for state employees handling drafting, research, hiring support, document review, benefits interactions, and case processing.
solution_summary: The Commonwealth of Pennsylvania expanded a governed generative AI program built around ChatGPT Enterprise and agency-specific AI-enabled service workflows. Employees across 35 agencies use ChatGPT Enterprise for drafting communications, summarizing materials, conducting research, brainstorming, and helping HR staff analyze state job requirements against comparable federal positions, with human review kept mandatory. In service delivery, the Department of Human Services uses AI to scan client-uploaded documents for blurriness, image quality, and relevance before caseworkers continue processing, and related AI-assisted enhancements feed into COMPASS to improve customer service, lower SNAP errors, and speed applications. The Board of Pardons uses AI to transfer data from handwritten clemency applications into its online tracking system. Labor & Industry rebuilt unemployment chatbots so AI maps broader user phrasing to curated answers and escalates unsupported questions to live representatives.
products_used: Board of Pardons online tracking system

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides governed generative AI assistance for employee drafting, summarization, research, brainstorming, and HR job-analysis tasks.

solution_components.name: COMPASS
solution_components.role: Receives AI-assisted enhancements used by DHS to improve customer service, reduce SNAP error rates, and process applications faster.

solution_components.name: Board of Pardons online tracking system
solution_components.role: Stores information transferred from handwritten clemency applications with AI assistance.

solution_components.name: UC benefits chatbot
solution_components.role: Handles unemployment benefits questions by matching varied user phrasing to preapproved responses and escalating exceptions to live staff.

solution_components.name: UC taxes chatbot
solution_components.role: Handles employer unemployment tax questions using the same curated-response and escalation pattern.

data_flow: Commonwealth employees send drafting, research, and analysis prompts through ChatGPT Enterprise and then review outputs before use. Public users upload documents to DHS systems, where AI checks image quality and relevance before caseworkers continue processing and COMPASS workflows consume the results. Handwritten clemency applications are converted into the Board of Pardons online tracking system, while unemployment users query AI-enabled chatbots that either return curated answers or route the interaction to live representatives.
integration_points: Federal workforce position information used for hiring comparisons
business_outcome: Pennsylvania scaled governed AI use from a pilot to statewide operations, saving employee time, improving document intake quality, increasing automated resolution in unemployment support, and using AI-assisted enhancements to improve customer service, reduce SNAP error rates, and speed application processing.
architecture_clues: Governance is enforced through a Generative AI Governing Board, policies, guidelines, and required training.
Human review remains essential for employee use of generative AI.
The unemployment chatbots do not generate novel answers and escalate out-of-scope questions to live representatives.
The source describes AI embedded into existing Commonwealth systems rather than a newly named standalone data platform.
